name: AWS DynamoDB Patterns
summary: Builds and operates DynamoDB access patterns (design, refactor, runtime contract, backup/restore, audits, performance-test and feature plans, vectors, IAM, encryption, Streams, DAX, provisioning) as proposals gated on user approval, citing a per-claim evidence ledger.
security_notes: Static by default. Produces code, IaC and CLI as proposals; never runs writes, deployment, backfill, deletion, restore, feature changes or load tests without confirmed target, blast radius, rollback and user approval. Restores go to a new table. Never requests credentials or prints customer items.
